terms.comment: An ordinary phrase, not a coinage: jūs, the right or permission to do a thing (see permission), with the gerund, as Livy has jūs māteriae caedendae (5.55, in Lewis & Short). No reference work has a term for read access.

sources: Lewis & Short: jus · Lewis & Short: lego. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
